title: Refrigerator Sensor Open
shortDescription: Fridge compartment thermistor is open circuit.
fullDescription:
Error 1 on Sharp refrigerators indicates the fresh-food thermistor is reading open. Temperature regulation is unreliable until replaced.

The code display can show as '1' or 'Er 1' depending on model.

title: Freezer Sensor Open
fullDescription:
Error 2 indicates the freezer compartment sensor is open. The freezer may run constantly or not at all.

Replace the sensor.

faq.a: Move to backup freezer until fixed.

title: Evaporator Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Evaporator coil thermistor is out of range.
fullDescription:
Error 3 indicates the evaporator thermistor failure. Defrost cycles may not run correctly.

Replace sensor clipped to coil.

title: Defrost Heater Fault
fullDescription:
Error 4 indicates the defrost heater element is open or the bimetal thermostat is faulty. Frost builds on evaporator until resolved.

Test and replace failed component.

fixSteps.title: Test & replace
fixSteps.instruction: Check heater/bimetal continuity; swap as needed.

faq.a: About every 8-12 hours of compressor runtime.

title: Fan Motor Fault
shortDescription: Evaporator or condenser fan has stopped.
fullDescription:
Error 5 indicates a fan motor has failed to produce expected feedback. Check for ice or debris, then test motor.

Can affect either evaporator or condenser fan depending on model.

fixSteps.title: Replace motor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new fan motor if needed.

whenToCallPro: If uncertain which fan is at fault.

faq.a: Yes - evaporator and condenser; check both.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: Loss of comms between main board and display.
fullDescription:
Error 6 indicates failed communication between the main control board and the front display. Check ribbon connectors.

May also occur after a power surge.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Open control housing and reseat harnesses.

title: Inverter Compressor Error
fullDescription:
Error 7 indicates the inverter board failed to start or run the compressor. Causes include a failing inverter module or a damaged compressor winding.

Professional service is typical.

fixSteps.title: Service call
fixSteps.instruction: Technician to diagnose and replace inverter/compressor.

faq.a: Depends on age; get quote first.

title: Damper Motor Fault
shortDescription: Air damper stuck or not responding.
fullDescription:
Error 8 indicates the damper that controls cold-air flow has failed to move or report position. Fridge temperature will be incorrect.

Replace damper assembly.
symptoms: Fridge too cold or too warm

fixSteps.title: Access damper
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear fridge panel or damper housing.

whenToCallPro: If uncertain about locating the damper.

faq.a: Not recommended; cold air distribution needs it.

title: Door Open Alarm
shortDescription: Door left open beyond alarm delay.
fullDescription:
Error 9 is a door-open alert after about 2-3 minutes of open door. Close the door to clear; if persistent, check door switch.

Informational alert, not a hard fault.

fixSteps.title: Close door
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure door closes fully and seals.

title: Plasmacluster / Ion Generator Fault
fullDescription:
Error 10 indicates the Plasmacluster ion generator has failed. Cooling continues normally; only the air-purification feature is affected.

Replace the Plasmacluster module.

fixSteps.title: Access module
fixSteps.instruction: Remove interior cover to reach plasmacluster unit.

faq.a: Fridge still cools; feature is cosmetic air purification.
